brief:
The collapse of a residential building in Gaza killed 21 people and wounded 45 others, the majority of them children and women, according to Shehab Wire. The incident, referred to as the "Al-Saada Building" disaster, left dozens trapped in the rubble.

The agency characterized the collapse as a warning of further catastrophes ahead, noting that Palestinian casualties continue to mount amid ongoing conflict in the territory.

title: Building collapse in Gaza kills 21, mostly children and women
